title: privileged evidence (v1)
description: Outcome vocabulary for the privileged lane. Privileged tests exercise real /dev/kvm, /dev/net/tun, cgroup-v2 mutation, Firecracker/jailer, TAP/netns, and seccomp. Every privileged artifact MUST be paired with a host_preflight block so reviewers can prove the result was produced by a real substrate and not by a mock. A run that records pass=true while the host lacks KVM is the canonical safety violation this schema rejects.

allOf.description: Fail-closed gate: when host_preflight.kvm_ok is false, no run may record pass=true. This is the canonical anti-mock rule: a privileged test cannot claim success when the substrate it depends on is unavailable. A blocked lane emits pass=false on every run with blocked_reason set at the top level.

class.description: Constant discriminator. Every privileged evidence artifact sets this to 'privileged' so downstream tooling can branch on lane without parsing the file name.

host_preflight.description: Snapshot of the host substrate at the moment the privileged lane started. Required for every privileged artifact; the same preflight also drives the host_preflight.v1.json standalone artifact. This block is the evidence that the runs below were actually executed against a real KVM/TUN/cgroup substrate.

substrate.description: Virtualization substrate. 'kvm' on Linux with /dev/kvm, 'hvf' on macOS (not supported by this project but reserved for portability), or 'none' when no hardware accelerator is available (the lane is blocked in that case).

kvm_ok.description: True iff /dev/kvm is accessible by the runner (open + KVM_GET_API_VERSION succeeded) AND the API version is at least 12. Drives the anti-mock rule: see the allOf block above.

kvm_api_version.description: KVM API version reported by KVM_GET_API_VERSION. Firecracker requires >= 12. Stored as -1 when the device was inaccessible so the field is always present and reviewers can see the negative.

tun_ok.description: True iff /dev/net/tun is accessible (open + TUNGETIFF ioctl). TAP networking requires this; missing TUN forces every networking test to be blocked.

cgroup_v2_ok.description: True iff the host is running a unified cgroup-v2 hierarchy and at least the cpu, memory, and pids controllers are available on the parent cgroup. CgroupUnavailable is the typed error when this is false.

nested_ok.description: True iff nested virtualization is available (KVM_CAP_NESTED on /dev/kvm). Required only for the direct-KVM educational subset; the Firecracker lane does not require it. Recorded for transparency, not gated by the anti-mock rule.

vulnerabilities.description: Host CPU vulnerability status relevant to microVM isolation (e.g. 'spectre_v2:mitigated', 'mds:mitigated', 'tsx_async_abort:not affected'). Empty list means no known relevant vulnerabilities were detected.

runs.description: Per-test outcomes. Each item is a privileged run that attempted to exercise a real substrate (KVM/TUN/cgroup/Firecracker). Three meaningful states: pass=true (real success), pass=false + blocked=true (skipped because of a host gap recorded in blocked_reason), pass=false + blocked=false (real failure with diagnostics in artifacts).

name.description: Stable identifier for the privileged test (e.g. 'firecracker_boot::create_start_stop', 'tap_netns::per_vm_isolation').

pass.description: True iff the test exercised a real substrate and matched its expected outcome. False on real failure or blocked. The allOf rule above forbids pass=true when host_preflight.kvm_ok is false.

blocked.description: True iff the test was skipped because of a host gap (e.g. no /dev/kvm, missing controller, unavailable binary). A blocked run carries pass=false by definition.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the test in milliseconds; reported as a non-negative integer even for blocked runs (where it is the time spent probing the host).

artifacts.description: Repository-relative paths to evidence files for this run (logs, snapshots, cgroup dumps, netns listings). Empty array is valid for blocked runs.

blocked_reason.description: Single human/machine-readable reason the lane is blocked, or null when the lane ran. Use null for successful or genuinely failed (non-blocked) runs. Use a short stable token (e.g. 'kvm_unavailable', 'cgroup_v2_missing', 'firecracker_binary_missing') so downstream tooling can pattern-match.

summary.description: Aggregate counts. Must satisfy: total == runs.length; pass + fail + blocked == total. Reviewers MUST reject artifacts where the math does not reconcile; json-schema cannot count, so the validator only checks the field shape.

total.description: Total number of run items recorded. Must equal runs.length.

fail.description: Number of runs where pass==false AND blocked==false.
